April 29, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Yost Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Nexstar Media Group Inc (NXST) by 1.81% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Yost Capital Management Llc bought 6,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 388,933 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $30.41 million, up from 382,033 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Yost Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Nexstar Media Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.89 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 3.16% or $2.05 $62.75. About 427,936 shares traded. Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:NXST) has declined 3.18% downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.73% the S&P500.
